rv.q: “The Color Purple” has been born again, and its conversion is a glory to behold.
Like everything else in the show, the musical elements are a far-from-seamless mix, alternating flat stretches with stirring peaks, and too many songs feel incomplete.
But it never slows down long enough for you to embrace it.
The show itself remains a rouser...'The Color Purple' looks lustrous indeed.
The Color Purple is a show that succeeds not because of its individual parts, but because of how beautifully those parts work together to create something greater than the sum of its components.
Making an impressive Broadway debut director Gary Griffin has turned The Color Purple into a glorious rarity, a pure life affirming entertainment that is a thrill to behold.
